limits: The map fixes city geography; generated lots do not identify individual 1871 buildings or addresses.
The 1869 municipal outline bounds context; Mitchell's 1870 sheet does not cover every western and southern annexation, so peripheral street and settlement patterns are reconstructed.
Generic period building forms, textures, vegetation and center-pivot bridge details are bounded reconstructions, not photographic matches.
City population, households and building totals are separate historical quantities; the contextual instance count is not a census count.

mitchell_1870.means: lettered on the 1870 map at this line, read through the map_control affine

plat.means: the plat name, unchanged, on a line the 1870 map draws

made_land.means: on made land east of the 1871 shore or later park ground; not drawn

street_names.note: T-3684. Inside the core polygon every street is a platted line named from 1870-71 sources (name_basis on each segment: edwards_1871, mitchell_1870, plat; unread = drawn on the 1870 map, name not legible, name null). Outside it the mapped arterials run on splines through their traced points; the lattice (name null, name_basis reconstructed) fills whole blocks between them.
